title: Administration of Justice (DNA) (Amendment) Bill, 2026
text:
Legal Supplement Part A to the “Trinidad and Tobago Gazette”, Vol. 65,
No. 100, 4th June, 2026
First Session Thirteenth Parliament Republic of
Trinidad and Tobago
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO
Act No. 13 of 2026
[L.S.]
BILL
AN ACT to amend the Administration of Justice
(Deoxyribonucleic Acid) Act, Chap. 5:34
[Assented to 1st June, 2026]
ENACTED by the Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago as
E n a c tm en t
follows:
1. This Act may be cited as the Administration of
Short title
Justice (Deoxyribonucleic Acid) (Amendment) Act, 2026.
2. In this Act, “the Act” means the Administration of
Interpretation
Justice (Deoxyribonucleic Acid) Act.
392 No. 13 Administration of Justice 2026
(Deoxyribonucleic Acid) (Amendment)
3. Section 4 of the Act is amended, by inserting in the
Section 4 amended
appropriate alphabetical sequence, the following
definitions:
“ “foreign terrorist fighter” has the
meaning assigned to it under section
15A of the Anti-Terrorism Act;
Chap. 12:07
“returnee” means a person who is
entering Trinidad and Tobago—
(a) from a declared geographical
area within the meaning
assigned to it under section 2(1)
of the Anti-Terrorism Act,
where terrorist acts as defined
under section 2(1) of the Anti-
Terrorism Act have occurred or
are occurring and who was
detained in a facility, camp or
place of detention in a declared
geographical area; or
(b) who the Minister with
responsibility for the
Anti-Terrorism Act, has
reasonable grounds to believe
poses a threat or risk of
committing a terrorist act and
who is not a foreign terrorist
fighter.
4. Section 16(1) of the Act is amended, by inserting
Section 16 amended
after the words “outside of Trinidad and Tobago,”, the
words “or is a returnee under section 4 or is deemed to
be a foreign terrorist fighter under section 4,”.
No. 13 Administration of Justice 2026 393
(Deoxyribonucleic Acid) (Amendment)
Passed in the House of Representatives this 15th day
of May, 2026.
Clerk of the House
Passed in the Senate this 22nd day of May, 2026.
